description: Details of (environmental management plan) pursuant to Condition 6 of planning permission P/2012/0338 dated 14/12/0338 dated 14/12/2012 for Redevelopment (following demolition of existing industrial/warehouse buildings) to provide a mixed use development of two buildings.  Western block - up to six storeys:  33 affordable housing units (1,2,3 and 4 bedroom units) and site management office.  Eastern block - up to eight storeys, 91 private residential units (1,2 and 3 bedroom units), 589sqm of office space (Use Class B1) and child care facility (Use Class D1) of 478sqm.  Vehicular access off Colonial Drive and provision of 12 disabled parking spaces and four integral cycle stores.  Ground floor plant and refuse/recycling areas.  Provision of footpath on north boundary to link Bollo Lane to Chiswick Business Park, associated public realm, landscaping and children;s play space
